notes.title: New Diebrary Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Diebrary Patch 1.1.1: Auto Aim and Fire![/h1]

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]

In this patch we've added [b]two new gameplay settings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/15916d20d641fd09e4a0468a3744a60c35c71801.gif[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Auto Aim[/b][list]
    [*]When enabled, automatically point your primary weapon in the direction of the nearest enemy
[/list]
    [*][b]Auto Shoot[/b][list]
    [*]Your Fire-button becomes a toggle for automatically firing your primary weapon
    [*]Quickly toggle off shooting to reach a pet in need of rescue, then toggle it back on to resume the carnage!
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where damage would be increased +12% each level with no drawback
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ad3f998016800fb8d23be4813166a033506d18a0.png[/img]

[h1][b]Diebrary Update 1.1.0: SHMUP Fest![/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]

We've heard your feedback! Many players have said that the base game speed is too slow, so we have [b]increased the overall pace of gameplay.[/b] While the 15 minute timer remains the same, the game itself is a bit faster paced - with characters and enemies all moving faster, shooting faster, and generally being more action-packed.

[h2][b]Pets[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added Charlotte, a cute potted plant that will periodically grant you powerful buffs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/63d1665087baea4db4617ff8281b200c79b10916.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ae0d893e586ec0a748037b8fecc2d63719cdf1d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/7bc5a201d88f310785327fdb4394269ace907d0f.png[/img]

    [*]Added Painterly, an adorable sea turtle that will send out a tsunami, pushes foes back

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/957257c2b17800859fa661d584576aa0ce30c7b8.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2][b]Plot Twists[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]We've added [Hard] and [Brutal] warnings on some of the most dangerous Plot Twists
    [*]Butterfingers: Reworked! Now deals much more damage to enemies, and tosses XP more consistently in all directions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/26afdc3aaa1f9e08ea141d7f74d116ad19b7bbca.gif[/img]

    [*]A Shocking Number of Explosions: Reworked! Now several smaller explosions can appear back-to-back, instead of a single large one. This can be used to your advantage, chain-explode enemies!
    [*]Paranormal Exercise: Ghost duration reduced from 10 -> 7s
    [*]Spring-Time Dancing: We lowered the difficulty/insanity of this act 1 twist
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed several crash bugs
    [*]Fixed an issue with knockback sending enemies extremely far away
[/list]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE CHANGE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/dff9d340442ec0be371681d875f013f8fe0513cf.png[/img]

Dear Diebrarians,

[h3]Due to an unforeseen issue with the final builds, we will need to move the launch date to [b]August 1st[/b].[/h3]

We're so excited to share what we have been working on, but unfortunately, there are a few last touches we need to make to ensure that you have the best experience possible with our game! :heart:

We hope that you understand, and look forward to seeing you all on [b]August 1st[/b]!

[h3]In the meantime, please feel free to [b]check our newly announced title[/b]:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877320/The_Walking_Dead_Betrayal/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3wmr9tCbh-U
